title: Hearty Umami Egyptian Sausage Skewers
description: A macrobiotic-friendly Egyptian dish featuring sausages, sashimi-cut and cooked to perfection, served in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, tomato paste, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the sliced onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the sausage pieces, onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the banana leaves on a flat surface and brush the center of each leaf with olive oil.
Place a skewer in the center of each banana leaf and fold the leaves over the skewer to form a packet.
Grill the packets for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausage is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
